svg.title: Mouse-deer and the Crocodiles
svg.desc: Paper-cut cover: tiny Kancil the mouse-deer, reddish-brown with thin legs and no antlers, stands on the left bank of a wide jungle river. Across the water a rambutan tree is full of red, hairy fruit. In the river, three crocodiles peek up, so that only their bumpy eyes, noses and ridged backs show.
